services.name: The Model

Dealer-carried financing and collections extend the operating relationship beyond the sale.

services.callout_title: A different kind of automotive franchise
services.callout_body: This guide helps you understand the operating model, identify the questions that matter, and prepare for formal review of the current Franchise Disclosure Document.

services.name: Owner Fit
services.short: The backgrounds and operating disciplines that can transfer.
services.headline: Who should explore Byrider?
services.summary: Business leaders prepared for engaged ownership, sufficient capitalization, and a complex operating model.
ideal_for: Experienced dealer principals evaluating dealer-carried finance.
Finance, lending, or collections leaders with strong operating discipline.
Multi-unit owners who know how to build teams and execute systems.
services.callout_body: Training supports the model, but no background or system guarantees results.

services.name: Support
services.short: Support across development, training, marketing, technology, and operations.
services.headline: Support across the operating journey
services.summary: You own the decisions. You do not have to build every function from scratch.
ideal_for: Market evaluation, site selection, facility planning, and opening preparation.
Training in sales, service, finance, accounting, compliance, and management.
includes: Marketing strategy and professionally developed campaign resources.
Executive Franchise Consultants and functional experts for ongoing guidance.
services.callout_body: Byrider franchise owner Dale Boone describes support that helps turn operating data into actionable tactics.

services.name: Technology

Illustrative image. Not an actual franchisee, employee, customer, or location.
services.callout_body: Technology supports execution; it does not replace disciplined management or independent diligence.

services.name: Investment
services.short: The questions and formal documents to review early.
services.headline: Investment questions to answer early
services.summary: The current initial franchise fee is $60,000 for a first location and $35,000 for each additional location purchased.
includes: Byrider currently lists ongoing royalties of 2.5% of gross vehicle sales and 1% of collections.
Review Item 7 of the current FDD for complete estimated investment information, assumptions, caps, and obligations.
services.callout_body: Byrider does not provide or guarantee franchisee financing; lender decisions remain subject to lender requirements and approval.

process.headline: Your diligence roadmap
process.summary: A serious franchise decision should become more specific at every step.

steps.title: Review the guide
steps.body: Write down the assumptions you need to test.

steps.title: Discuss the fit
steps.body: Share your background, market interest, timeline, and operating role.

steps.title: Review the current FDD
steps.body: Examine Items 7 and 19 with qualified legal and financial advisors.

steps.title: Validate the opening plan
steps.body: Confirm territory, site, financing, development, staffing, inventory, training, and launch requirements.

cta.headline: Bring better questions to the conversation.
cta.body: A guide can organize your questions. The current FDD, independent advice, and candid operating conversations should answer them.

steps.title: Know your market interests
steps.body: Identify where and how you want to operate.

steps.title: Know your role
steps.body: Decide how engaged you plan to be in day-to-day leadership.

steps.title: Know what must be verified
steps.body: Use Items 7 and 19 and qualified advisors before deciding.

cta.follow_up_promise: A Byrider Franchise Development representative will follow up using your preferred contact method.
